about_the_game:
The new DLC adds a whole new production chain focused on e-waste recycling. By collecting discarded electronics, you can process them with new specialized machines and create new products, including solar panels, batteries, and other modern electronics. This expands your recycling center with more ways to reuse materials and grow your operations.

The DLC also brings two new maps for you to explore. One map is based around a large solar plant, while the other is set in an electronics junkyard. Both locations serve as new sources of waste materials that you can collect and process back at your center.

With new machines, products, and maps, this expansion adds more variety to your recycling center. From turning e-waste into valuable resources to producing high-tech goods, the DLC gives you fresh ways to develop your center and keep it running.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Window 10 & 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700k or AMD Ryzen 3 1200X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 960 4GB or equivalent
  • Sound Card: Yes
